subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Utility Shutoff Scam
description: A quick, practical guide to The Utility Shutoff Scam.

hook.text: Your power company calls. Pay your overdue balance in the next hour or your electricity gets cut.

buildup.text: Scammers impersonate utility companies, demanding immediate payment to prevent service shutoff.

discovery.text: They demand payment via prepaid cards or wire transfer — methods real utilities never use.

twist.text: The scam spikes in winter and summer, when losing heat or air conditioning feels most urgent.

climax.text: Real utilities provide written notice and payment plans. They never demand same-day payment.

punchline.text: Your power is fine. Your panic is the product.

quiz.question: When do utility shutoff scams spike?
options: In winter and summer when losing service feels urgent
